<function name="IsConnectedAtSide" parent="CNavLadder" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns whether this <page>CNavLadder</page> has an outgoing ( one or two way ) connection **to** given <page>CNavArea</page> in given direction.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="navArea" type="CNavArea">The <page>CNavArea</page> to test against.</arg>
		<arg name="navDirType" type="number">The direction, in which to look for the connection. See <page>Enums/NavDir</page></arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Whether this <page>CNavLadder</page> has an outgoing ( one or two way ) connection **to** given <page>CNavArea</page> in given direction.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
